notes.title: The Grandiose Tales of Cpt. Stuffy - Out Now!
notes.content: [p][b]Follow a short new tale set in the Restitched game universe![/b] Sail through the imaginative minds of brother-sister duo Charlie and Eloise Dior as they conjure up exciting challenges and triumphs for their brand-new themed Stuffy plushies. [b]At the end of the comic, you'll even meet a couple of familiar faces from the upcoming Restitched game![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/6a67ba627e686ebdc93df8e0e00f7e314540dee0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]After many months of releasing individual comic pages on Patreon, [b]the full story is now available in a lovely full-packaged experience![/b][/p][p][/p][p align="initial"][b]Thank you to all of the trixel+ members who have followed along with us each month as the comic was illustrated and developed.[/b] Without your support, we wouldn't be able to create this fun side project with our artists, and we certainly wouldn't be able to expand the world of Restitched![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/70ab1d512b444f8e239805e2791474ad869c0237.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Experience the story across 41 beautifully-illustrated pages:[/b][/h3][h1][url="https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/the-grandiose-tales-of-cpt-stuffy/issue-1/viewer?title_no=1087367&episode_no=1" style="button"]Read Free (WebToon)[/url][/h1]

notes.title: Restitched: Recapped! | 6 Months of Progress
notes.content:
[p][b]It's hard to believe we're already halfway through 2025![/b] [/p][p][b]We've made [i]significant[/i] progress toward the game after our Official Trailer premiered in December.[/b] You'll be no stranger to all the awesome things we've been cooking up if you're a follower of our social media, subscribe to our Patreon, or are in our Discord server![/p][p][/p][p]Following public feedback on our latest trailer, we put our heads down and began tinkering away at the game for the first couple of months this year. [b]We've read nearly every public suggestion[/b] and, as a result, [b]have improved player movement and global gravity.[/b] -- [b]No more floaty physics![/b] [i]Oops[/i]![/p][p][/p][p][b]We've also been working very hard on finishing up one of the main pillars of the game called 'The Wardrobe'.[/b] This is the character customization aspect, and we're [i][b]almost[/b][/i][b] done[/b] with it! [/p][p]We've also recently announced that [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1361090/view/526467189812757010?l=english"]Wardrobe Testing will begin this year[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/42827ed451971580b7208b8699a612286469cf5c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]We're truly grateful for your support and patience as we aim to develop our dream game...[/b][/p][p]We'd still like to remind everyone that [b]Restitched is only a hobbyist passion project for us[/b], and isn't our job! As such, development takes time, and we're focused on creating a game we can be proud of and one you can enjoy...[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Recapped Development Posts[/b][/u][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/ae97ef0074141b4902ac5a11839fa76bb361e1c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]If [u]you[/u] would like to read up on our open development progress, be sure to check out our monthly development posts![/b] There are now six jam-packed posts from 2025, with each one covering a single month of progress. They're especially interesting if you're a fan of behind-the-scenes and early content![/p][h2][url="https://www.patreon.com/collection/3913?view=expanded" style="button" buttoncolor="#fe347b"]Recapped Posts Collection[/url][/h2][p]
Each month brings loads of bug fixes, improvements, changes, assets, concepts, music, and new features... [b]We're steadily chipping away at all our tasks and are very proud of how far we've come... yet also excited for where we're headed![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Curious about the progress, but aren't quite interested in the dev posts? Check out this awesome 2025 overview video by community member [i]PlushPiney:[/i][/b][/p][h2][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jhFAoQN5nmE" style="button"]Watch YouTube Video[/url][/h2][p][img src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/jhFAoQN5nmE/hq720.jpg?sqp=-oaymwEnCNAFEJQDSFryq4qpAxkIARUAAIhCGAHYAQHiAQoIGBACGAY4AUAB&rs=AOn4CLAESpHdz03WdfcQRSWpo5U9VRsi6Q"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Follow Development with "Restitched: Recapped!"
notes.content:
Howdy-hey, Stuffies,

We know you might be eager to get your plush paws on Restitched, and to help tide you over during the wait we'd like to remind you that we've opened up our development journey so you can follow along with us as we build the game each month!

Starting back in December 2021, we've published a new [i]Restitched: Recapped![/i] development post each month. These posts offer a glimpse into our creative process and first-time development journey. In the posts, you'll see our process us as we learn, grow, and try things out!

[h1]Over 25 posts available now (and FREE)![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/571ea0361c0139c20468a7b757f191985665f5c5.png[/img]
Whether you just want to check out the latest developments or start from the beginning, there's loads of exciting development recaps already available! You can find them on our Patreon - but don't worry, they're [i]free[/i]. 

[h2][url=https://www.patreon.com/collection/3913]Catch up on Restitched: Recapped! here![/url][/h2]

You can also join our [url=https://www.trixelcreative.com/plus]"trixel+" Patreon service[/url] for only $3/mo (USD) to get early access to select posts (like Recapped!), along with [b]nearly 300 exclusive posts[/b] and the opportunity to cast your vote in development polls.

[h1]When will we hear more about Restitched?[/h1]
While we're just a hobbyist team of developers, we're doing our best to push the project forward and have already hit new milestones. We're really excited about where we're headed, and can't wait to share an official, polished update in the (hopefully near) future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/9c276a43e222185ca457fcc5c3ea272e3ca43820.jpg[/img]
We're currently working toward a private building test, in which handpicked friends and developers will test the game's primary level editor tools. Afterward, we'll continue working on the final goals needed to produce our second official trailer for the game - which is already underway.

We'd like to thank everyone that supports us along this journey, including all you lovely folks that have wishlisted the game here on Steam. It means the world to us, and we couldn't do this without you!

[h1]How can I stay in the loop?[/h1]
We're still a ways off from any type of release, but if you'd like to be more involved in the Restitched community then you can join our [url=http://discord.gg/q8E2hr4]official Discord server[/url]! 

Another great way to stay informed is to follow us on social media, like [url=https://twitter.com/RestitchedGame]@RestitchedGame[/url] on Twitter (X), and trixelcreative on Instagram.

notes.title: Restitched Reveal Trailer
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a minute. Did you miss us? Well, Stuffy certainly missed you. So much in fact, that they've decided to star in an exciting new announcement - the [b]Restitched Reveal Trailer[/b]!

That's right, it's [i]finally[/i] here. You can now watch the premiere trailer for Restitched! We've been working so incredibly hard for over two years to make this game for you all, and we're thrilled to finally share this new glimpse of it. We truly hope you'll enjoy what you see, and keep in mind that this doesn't yet scratch the surface of our plans for the game! [b]We're still in pre-alpha development, so many things will change and improve with time[/b].

Accompanying the trailer is an updated Steam store page and Restitched site page. These two platforms now include new screenshots, info, and the trailer itself. In case you've missed it, we've also updated the Restitched FAQ page recently, so there's plenty of new information to catch up on!

If you're a content creator or the press (journalist, etc.) and wish to cover Restitched, please see our new Restitched Press Guide [url=https://www.trixelcreative.com/restitched-press]here[/url]. This contains an overview of information on the game, as well as its history. You'll also find a pretty hefty media kit file to download, which includes logos, icons, graphics, screenshots, renders, and more!

If you've not yet seen the trailer, what are you waiting for?! Check it out now!

[previewyoutube=3R7e1X8UE7k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Style-A-Stuffy Contest
notes.content:
We're very excited to announce the second-ever community contest for Restitched... 'Style-A-Stuffy'! This time around, [b]you'll be designing your very own addition to Stuffy's wardrobe! [/b]

We're working with our very talented Lead Modeler to host this contest, in which [b]any community member can draw up their own outfit idea[/b] for our plush pal. The winning outfit will be adapted into the game for everyone to use!

Entries are not solely based on quality, but rather your imagination. You don't even need to be an artist to take part! As long as your idea comes across and is original and imaginative, then your entry is valid! Additionally, [b]we've included a printable reference sheet so that non-digital artists can draw and color their entry too.[/b]

[u][b]Contest Dates:[/b][/u]
[b]Start:[/b] January 9, 2022 
[b]End:[/b] January 26, 2022 @ 11:59pm (CST)

[b]Read more about the contest, including how to participate, by clicking >> [url=https://www.trixelcreative.com/post/restitched-contest-style-a-stuffy]here[/url]. <<[/b]

notes.title: Introducing 'Restitched: Recapped!'
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/ba35c2e0f575ea4fd26642aa07ae81302aee928a.jpg[/img]

[b]Introducing a brand-new exciting feature: Restitched: Recapped![/b]

It's clear that you love to see behind-the-scenes work towards Restitched. In fact, the Restitched: Dev Diary feature is by far our most popular feature on trixel+. While the Dev Diary feature offers carefully curated and in-depth articles spanning the entire development history, [b]Restitched: Recapped! offers a more personal and casual insight into the team[/b]. 

[b]This new feature explores the progress that took place on Restitched the previous month.[/b] You'll often see work-in-progress content, team discussions, development images, concepts, and more. These posts could be just one paragraph long, or a complete article!

A massive influence behind this series was the recent trixel+ feedback form. It was clear that you want more transparency from us, and want to see more from our individual developers. Well, rest assured, we heard you![b] These new posts will be available first on trixel+, and will remain exclusive for only two weeks, before being posted in full on the Trixel Creative website.[/b]

The best part, though? [b]You can read the first entry in the new feature right now![/b] 'Restitched: Recapped! - November 2021' is now available on the Trixel Creative website, and details some of our behind the scenes work on the game from last month. 

[b]If you're interested in seeing a small glimpse into what we've been up to,[/b] [url=https://www.trixelcreative.com/post/restitched-recapped-november-2021]Click here to check it out![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41276180/af45cd23a3f694f553f38ebcf903c10bee07fbd9.png[/img]

notes.title: Questions? Read the Restitched FAQ!
notes.content:
[b]We've received a lot of common questions from the community, which is why we've curated a special FAQ page on our website to address several of them![/b]

While we're still very early in development at the time of writing this, we realize there are some questions worth answering and being transparent about. However, we can't reveal too much at this time, as things are constantly changing behind the scenes! 

If your question isn't addressed on the FAQ page yet, please sit tight and we'll be sure to update you as development continues. :)
